description:
Remembers your habits, builds Agent teams, automates the repetitive work


This update lets the Agent operate your Chrome directly, adds screenshots and screen recording, and lets Mini Apps open local files. The sidebar is clearer and the Agent can tidy it for you, and you can build a personal knowledge base in Space.

New and Improved

- Let the Agent operate your Chrome: Install the Chrome extension and the Agent can open pages, click, fill in forms, and upload files in your signed-in Google Chrome. It runs in a separate background window and asks you to take over for sign-ins or CAPTCHAs.
- Build a personal knowledge base in Space: Upload or drag in local folders and files, save files the Agent creates, and organize everything into project folders. Use @ in a conversation to bring in existing materials, and set organizing rules that work with scheduled tasks to keep collecting new ones.
- Screenshots, scrolling captures, and screen recordings, right in the chat: Click the screenshot button in the input box or press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+S to annotate a screenshot, take a scrolling capture, or record your screen. The result is added to the input box as an attachment and sent only after you confirm.
- Open files with Mini Apps: Once a Mini App that supports the file type is installed, choose it under Open With in Finder or File Explorer. Matching files in the chat open with it first, too.
- A clearer sidebar the Agent can tidy for you: The sidebar is split into Pinned, Projects, and Tasks, with drag-to-reorder. The Agent can also pin items, move them into projects, and reorder them, and you can answer questions, approve requests, and retry other conversations right from the sidebar.
- A tidier built-in browser you can take over anytime: The Agent reuses open tabs first and closes temporary pages when done, while pages you opened or interacted with stay put. Page reading is leaner and uses fewer tokens, and every browser step appears in the conversation as the actual action. While the Agent is working, click "Take over" at the top of the browser page to get control back.
- Create an extension with one sentence: An extension is a small program inside a plugin. Describe what you need and the Agent writes one that adds a status bar above the input box or a panel on the side, calls the plugin's own tools, and helps draft messages. Preview it in the current conversation first, then install it for all conversations.

Fixes

- Fixed some known issues.
